claim_one_line: THE WORD SIDE OF THE RECORD COUNT, VERIFIED ON MAIN (re-banks the SM seat's W110, proof before checks before run; main re-derived the proof, ran its own census with its own count for the left moves, to n = 5; the seat's run reproduced byte for byte), AND WHAT THE COMMON POINT IS (the web seat's read of 2026-10-20 night, checked): for n >= 3 no non-trivial conjugacy class of F_n keeps even its cyclic length under every R_ij^{+-1} -- Whitehead's count |R_ij(w)| = m + n_i - 2c_ij forces (n - 2) n_i <= 0 -- so none is kept by the transvections, even up to inversion; at n = 2 the classes kept by the record's R and L are the powers of [a, b], whose trace is PF1's kappa. So for n >= 2 a non-trivial kept object, a class or an SL(2, C) character, exists exactly when n = 2: the input of GENESIS v1.49 is equivalent to two records, not weaker -- GM1 is characterised, not derived (regraded in v1.50, P-212); the word side needs no target; the count of two rests on the democratic extension of the moves (a surface's moves keep the boundary word at every genus; genus 2 checked); persistence means fixed up to conjugation. 0 of 19.
